verdict.rationale: Groq documents official SDKs (TypeScript SDK on GitHub, Python via OpenAI-compatible client) with concrete usage examples for chat, streaming, tool use, structured outputs, transcription, and MCP integration, showing a mature developer-facing API surface for building agentic applications. missing for 10: independent third-party validation of SDK quality/maintenance (only GitHub repo cited, no changelog/release cadence or broader community praise specifically about SDK ergonomics), and no explicit multi-language SDK list beyond TypeScript/OpenAI-compatible Python.
